howToApply: Prefer to apply in person? Stop by the front desk with a résumé or call (918) 540-1929.

insurance.intro: Plans change, so have your insurance card or plan information handy when you call. **Not every plan has a card.** We'll do our best to check your coverage before your visit.

groups.name: Medicare Advantage — Oklahoma Plans
groups.note: Medicare Advantage plans take the place of Regular Medicare. They are state-specific, so we can only accept Oklahoma plans.

groups.name: Oklahoma Medicaid
groups.note: Glasses coverage depends on your age and your Medicaid plan. Some plans cover glasses and some don't. We do our best to verify yours before your visit. We can't file Medicaid from other states.

boxes.title: Vision plan or medical insurance?
boxes.text:
Your eyes can be covered two ways:
- **Vision plan** (like VSP or EyeMed): routine eye exams, glasses and contacts.
- **Medical insurance:** medical eye care, like diabetic eye exams, testing and treatment for eye disease such as glaucoma and macular degeneration, and urgent problems like infections, injuries and sudden vision changes.
Please bring both cards, even for a routine exam. Some vision plans cover medical testing too, and we'll check yours.
**Sometimes we accept a plan's medical insurance but not its vision benefits.** Check the plans we accept above, or give us a call if you're not sure.
